svg.title: Qualifying and admitting a switched o2at path
svg.desc: Forwarding, occupied bandwidth, burst limits and delay must all be qualified for a particular Layer-2 path. PCP is a scheduling request, and receiver credits alone do not protect an intermediate switch queue.
